_note: Initial guesses, tuned per place by the morning tap and the owner's weights. Values are fractional effects (0.3 = +30%).

holiday._note: Public holiday effect depends on area type, picked at onboarding.

_match_tv_note: Recalibrated 7 Oct 2026: Swiggy reported IPL 2026 dineout bookings +41% and delivery orders +32% year on year (platform PR, so indicative). Cafes stay slightly negative, restaurants positive.

multiplier_cap._note: Per-hour cap on the product of all signals, so stacked signals cannot produce absurd forecasts.

payday._note: Salaried India is paid around the 1st to 7th. No solid dining-specific study found; these are small starting guesses that taps and owner weights tune. Office areas respond more than residential. Weekends in the first 10 days are boosted.

aqi._note: Delhi study (Blue Sky Analytics and Near, Oct 2019 to Mar 2020): footfall in Karol Bagh, Lodhi Gardens and Connaught Place fell up to 33% as PM2.5 rose; Connaught Place went from about 17,000 to 14,000 a day at PM2.5 336. Categories follow India's CPCB PM2.5 breakpoints. Daytime (8 am to 10 pm) mean PM2.5 in ug/m3.
